controller.description: Controller connection settings. Omit this field to run without fleet management.

inventoryInterval.description:
Interval between inventory refreshes. Defaults to `15m`.

Discovery walks user home directories and developer-tool configuration
files, so this trades inventory freshness against local disk activity.

llmGateway.description: LLM gateway used by managed developer tools.

programs.description: Per-program settings reconciled on this device.

sandbox.description: Local execution sandbox required for managed developer tools.

telemetry.description: Telemetry collected from managed developer tools.

ClaudeCodeConfig.description:
Settings reconciled into Claude Code's managed configuration.

Arbitrary keys are written directly to Agentdesktop's managed-settings
drop-in. Generated gateway settings take precedence when values overlap.

auth.description: Upstream authentication used by this agent.

useLlmGateway.description: Whether this program uses the top-level LLM gateway.

ClaudeDesktopConfig.description:
Settings reconciled into Claude Desktop's managed configuration.

Arbitrary keys are written directly to the managed settings file. Generated
gateway settings take precedence when values overlap.

auth.description: Upstream authentication used by this agent.

useLlmGateway.description: Whether this program uses the top-level LLM gateway.

CodexConfig.description:
Settings reconciled into Codex's organization-managed configuration.

Values under `managedConfig` are written to Codex's `managed_config.toml`.
When generated LLM-gateway settings overlap with those values,
Agentdesktop's generated values take precedence.

managedConfig.description:
Arbitrary values written to Codex's organization-managed TOML configuration.

Use Codex's native snake_case configuration keys. TOML has no null value,
so null values cannot be reconciled.

useLlmGateway.description: Whether this program uses the top-level LLM gateway.

ControllerConnectionConfig.description: Connection settings used by a daemon to reach the fleet controller.

address.description: HTTPS address of the controller's fleet API.

caCertificatePath.description:
Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the controller.

Omit this field to use the operating system's trusted certificate roots.

heartbeatInterval.description: Interval between device heartbeats. Defaults to `30s`.

LlmGatewayAuthentication.description: Authentication mechanisms supported by an LLM gateway.

oneOf.description: Request a short-lived JWT from the controller using the device identity.

allowedClientIds.description: Client identifiers permitted to request credentials for this gateway.

audience.description: Audience placed in the issued JWT. This must match the gateway's expected audience.

oneOf.description: Sign the local user in with OIDC and send the resulting access token.

allowInsecure.description: Permit loopback HTTP endpoints for isolated local development.

redirectUri.description: Loopback redirect URI registered for the native client.

LlmGatewayConfig.description: Connection and authentication settings for an LLM gateway.

authentication.description: Authentication mechanism used when connecting to this gateway.

url.description:
Base HTTP or HTTPS URL of the LLM gateway.

The URL must include a host and cannot include credentials, a query, or a fragment.

OpenCodeConfig.description:
Settings reconciled into OpenCode's system-managed configuration.

Values under `managedConfig` are written to OpenCode's managed JSONC file.
When generated LLM gateway settings overlap with those values,
Agentdesktop's generated values take precedence.

managedConfig.description: Arbitrary values written to OpenCode's system-managed configuration.

model.description:
Model ID selected from `models` when using the LLM gateway.

This is required when a top-level `llmGateway` is configured.

models.description:
Models exposed by the managed LLM gateway provider, keyed by model ID.

Each value is an arbitrary OpenCode model configuration object. At least
one model is required when a top-level `llmGateway` is configured.

useLlmGateway.description: Whether this program uses the top-level LLM gateway.

ProgramAuthentication.description: Upstream authentication selected by a managed agent.

oneOf.description:
Offer the model provider subscription associated with the local user.
The user may skip it and continue with gateway identity only.

ProgramsConfig.description: Settings for developer tools managed by Agentdesktop.

claudeCode.description: Claude Code managed-settings configuration. Arbitrary keys are passed through directly.

claudeDesktop.description: Claude Desktop managed configuration. Arbitrary keys are passed through directly.

SandboxConfig.description: Local execution restrictions applied to managed developer tools.

filesystem.description: Filesystem access available to sandboxed commands.

network.description: Network destinations available to sandboxed commands.

denied.description: Paths sandboxed commands may neither read nor modify.

writable.description: Additional paths sandboxed commands may modify.

allowedDomains.description: Domains sandboxed commands may contact. An empty set disables network access.

TelemetryConfig.description: Telemetry events collected from managed developer tools.

events.description: Event names to collect. `tool.use.input` implies `tool.use` and includes tool arguments.

oneOf.description: Tool invocation metadata and input. This implies `tool.use`.
